title: Reschedule Notice and the Starting Amount of the Ridgeline Installation Services Customer Reschedule Fee
content:
The customer reschedule fee on a Ridgeline Installation Services contract is worked out from a starting amount, and the starting amount is fixed by the reschedule notice. The starting amount is rounded only where the rule below says so; the customer reschedule fee worked out from it is rounded to the cent only at the end, no amount on the way to it being rounded.

## Notice rule

The reschedule notice is the number of calendar days from the date the reschedule request was registered to the original installation date recorded on the contract. The request is the most recent customer reschedule request on the contract that was carried out (request status completed), and the date that counts is the calendar date on which it was registered.

| Reschedule notice | Starting amount of the customer reschedule fee |
|---|---|
| 0 days: the request was registered on the original installation date itself, when the crew is already committed | the program's reschedule fee plus the program's trip charge |
| below 0 days: the request was registered after the original installation date | the program's reschedule fee plus the program's trip charge |
| exactly 1 day | the program's reschedule fee multiplied by the next-day notice multiple of 1.5, rounded to the cent |
| 2 days or more | the program's reschedule fee |

## Points of judgement

- The original installation date is the first installation date booked on the contract. Reschedules never change it, so the notice is always measured against that first date, not against the date currently booked.
- The program's reschedule fee and the program's trip charge are the figures of the installation program on the contract.

## Worked figures (hypothetical program reschedule fee 100.00, program trip charge 120.00, original installation date 18 April)

| Request registered | Reschedule notice | Starting amount |
|---|---|---|
| 25 April | below 0 days | 220.00 |
| 18 April | 0 days | 220.00 |
| 17 April | 1 day | 150.00 |
| 16 April | 2 days | 100.00 |
| 8 April | 10 days | 100.00 |

With a hypothetical program reschedule fee of 75.00, a notice of exactly 1 day gives a starting amount of 112.50; with 125.00 it gives 187.50.
